main.summary: Contains a consistent administrative view of a transfer session and its persisted recovery state.
main.remarks: The snapshot includes session and publication journal state together with the session's segmented ranges and stream chunks. Session and journal may be absent when no corresponding row exists.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Gets the transfer session, or null when it does not exist.

property.name: Journal
property.summary: Gets the publication journal, or null when no journal exists for the session.

property.name: SegmentedRanges
property.summary: Gets the persisted segmented transfer ranges ordered by offset.

property.name: StreamChunks
property.summary: Gets the persisted stream append chunks ordered by offset.
